brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A basket-dried green tea from Qingliu in Fujian, made by hand from plump buds of the Fuyun line picked before Guyu.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
history: It was developed in 1991 and sold mainly across Jiangsu. Little more is documented about it.
processing: Fixed in an electric pan, rubbed by hand, straightened and shaped, then dried fully over a gentle heat.
appearance_dry: Tight, straight, sharp-tipped strands thickly covered in down.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
